page.overview:
Who is Ancient Sacred Wyvern?

Ancient Sacred Wyvern is a character version of the card, "Ancient Sacred Wyvern". It appears in the video game Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's World Championship 2010: Reverse of Arcadia, as a Single Duel opponent.

You can unlock this opponent during Story Mode (clear chapter 2).
